status: frozen before any Gate A or Gate B main run; never changed after a main run starts (a change needs a new version and a new hidden split)
claim_rule: A level is claimed only on 3 seeds, hidden evaluation data, and a clean commit.

L1.name: Compressor-grade
L1.bpb_rule: held-out real-text BPB at or below min(PPM-C order 5, Kneser-Ney order 5) re-measured on the same stream at equal exposure bytes
L1.reference_note: Measured 2026-11-26 (docs/data.md). The rule re-measures the baselines at claim time; these values only show where the bar sits today. With 33 books the hidden role is a few books, so differences under about 0.05 BPB are not reliable.

L2.name: Fluent
L2.blind_rating: blind raters judge generated sentences locally grammatical
pending: the Wikipedia corpus is not in the manifest yet; the BPB threshold applies once a licensed Wikipedia held-out role exists

L3.name: Small LLM (1.0 target)
L3.blind_rating: coherent multi-sentence generation under blind rating

L4.name: Assistant
L4.requires: L3 plus instruction following and multi-turn dialogue on hidden human-written prompts, with calibrated abstention; thresholds frozen in the generation milestone

source_check: Thresholds are the roadmap's section 7.1 values. They have not yet been checked against the GPT-2 paper's small-model numbers or the BLiMP paper; that check is listed in docs/data.md as open work.
